feeds.description: Dickinson College's 60-acre certified organic working & educational farm. Mission is to inspire responsible land stewardship through study of the earth's natural processes and demonstrate the science, practice and culture of sustainable food production.

feeds.title: Broadfork Farm Blog
feeds.description: Ee are Bryan and Shannon! We grow beautiful, organic vegetables for people who love good food.We bring the gifts from our farm straight to market so it's easy to eat from farm-to-fork.

feeds.title: Homegrown Organic Farms Blog
feeds.description: Homegrown Organic Farms is an organic produce marketing company founded upon integrity, loyalty, and traditional agrarian values. We strive to provide a product of unsurpassed quality to our customer and the highest possible returns to our growers, while educating both on the promises of sustainable agriculture.

feeds.title: Tiny Farm Blog
feeds.description: A day-to-day photo-journal of organic market gardening: growing local food with two acres and some tools! I started this tiny farming blog in earnest about a year ago, with the clear idea that it was simply about my gardening efforts, about growing stuff. I didn't begin with a cause or a philosophical platform. I wasn't blogging with any audience in mind, it was just a personal field journal, available online, and as such, there was no central spot for politics.

feeds.title: Nirvana Organic Farm

These include raspberries, currants and gooseberries in summer to chestnuts in autumn and early winter available at the farm gate.

feeds.title: Gold Hill Organic Farm Blog

Picked straight from the soil each morning, the vegetables are bursting with the flavour and nutrients that only super-fresh food can provide.

feeds.title: Blue Sky Organic Farms
feeds.description: Blue Sky Organic Farms is a family farm located in Litchfield, AZ. We have been farming in sunny Arizona since 1995. We grow 100% of the produce we offer and are extremely proud to be certified organic.
